name: Gen1 Co-op (prototype)
description: Experimental overworld co-op prototype for up to 10 players. Fully in-game menu: START > GEN1COOP > HOST or JOIN (numeric keypad for the host's IP). Host relays every player's position to everyone else. Every outcome shows an in-game textbox, no console or config file editing needed. No visible remote players yet - this is step 1: prove the connections and relay work.
